name: paaipe-website-front-end
description: PAAIPE Public Information Portal - public website frontend only.

scripts.build: astro build && node scripts/prune-orphan-assets.mjs && tsx scripts/write-seo-files.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run pending:check && npm run metadata:check && npm run qa:check && npm run handoff:check && npm run verify:brand && npm run verify:social && npm run verify:contrast && npm run verify:leak && npm run verify:seo && npm run verify:html && npm run verify:links && npm run audit:content && npm run verify:budgets
scripts.build:review: PUBLIC_CONTENT_MODE=review sh -c "astro build && node scripts/prune-orphan-assets.mjs && tsx scripts/write-seo-files.mjs"
scripts.verify:leak: npm run verify:leak:review && npm run verify:leak:production
scripts.verify:leak:review: PUBLIC_CONTENT_MODE=review sh -c "astro build && node scripts/prune-orphan-assets.mjs && tsx scripts/write-seo-files.mjs && node scripts/verify-no-leak.mjs"
scripts.verify:seo: npm run verify:seo:review && npm run verify:seo:production
scripts.verify:seo:review: npm run build:review && PUBLIC_CONTENT_MODE=review tsx scripts/verify-seo.mjs
scripts.lighthouse: npm run build && tsx scripts/run-lighthouse.mjs --json docs/lighthouse.json
scripts.verify:html: npm run verify:html:review && npm run verify:html:production
scripts.audit:content: npm run audit:content:review && npm run audit:content:production
scripts.audit:content:review: npm run build:review && PUBLIC_CONTENT_MODE=review tsx scripts/verify-content-brand.mjs
